d: Jharkhand ke palamu ke manatu ki ilake men aphim ki kheti ko rokna ek bari chunauti hai. manatu ka ilaka pichhle ek dashak se aphim ki kheti ke lie pure desh bhar men charchit ho raha hai. kabhi ilaka naksal gatividhi ke lie charchit tha ab yah ilaka aphim ki kheti ke lie charchit huaa hai. manatu ka ilaka narkotiks ka ek naya rut ke rup men bhi devlap ho raha hai. is ilake men aphim ki kheti ke sath sath aphim ki taskari bhi ho rahi hai.
